performance_case.causal_mechanism: An effective systemd start deadline prevents a future one-shot carry evidence producer from occupying its phase indefinitely while retaining the existing inactive and disabled lifecycle boundary.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch proves only the exact timeout correction through static checks, focused tests and later Manager-side disposable Linux validation; it does not prove installation, execution, evidence, PnL, drawdown or promotion value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because the carry source remains inactive and unbound; any future path-risk benefit requires separately preregistered forward evidence.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A small four-file correction before deployment prevents a false bounded-runtime assumption, reduces the risk of a stuck capture phase and avoids corrupting the evidence SLA.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect is zero; the infrastructure benefit is a fail-closed 30-minute start deadline for a future evidence producer so a strategy mechanism can be accepted or rejected sooner.
